name: Rizzle's Schematics
summary: After Keeping Pace, you carry a raw indurium sample to Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats. Rizzle's plans lie beneath the ore, and his notes trace it to the dwarves' dig at Uldaman in the Badlands. They also describe how well indurium resists heat.

sections.title: Notes on Indurium
sections.body: Rizzle's plans explain how to refine indurium ore. Scrawled notes trace its source to the dwarves' dig at Uldaman in the Badlands. Other notes describe the ore's resistance to heat. A lump of raw indurium holds the plans down, and you take the sample to Pozzik.

sections.title: Pozzik's Verdict
sections.body: Pozzik finds indurium interesting. If it resists heat as well as you say, that may explain how much the gnomes have improved of late. The sample will be invaluable for tests, though Pozzik needs more before it can be of real use.

faq.q: Where does Rizzle get his indurium ore?
faq.answer: Rizzle's scrawls point to the dwarves' dig at Uldaman in the Badlands as the source of his indurium ore.

faq.q: What do Rizzle's notes say about indurium?
faq.answer: Rizzle's notes describe how to refine indurium, and many others concern its resistance to heat.

aliases: who do i turn this in to
faq.answer: You bring the sample to Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats.

faq.q: Where did this sample come from?
faq.answer: A lump of raw indurium ore held Rizzle's plans down as a paperweight.
